sections.text:
Engine and Software

Godot Engine was used as the main game engine for developing the project.

Fonts
Pixel Font Awesome by Somepx — purchased asset, used throughout the game.

https://somepx.itch.io/pixel-font-awesome

Balatro Original Paint Background Shader — Used as shader background in the card mini-game

godotshaders.com/shader/balatro-original-paint-background

Shader
Warped Fractal Noise Shader — used for the start menu background and credits.

https://godotshaders.com/shader/warped-fractal-noise/

Music and Sound Effects
Start Menu Sound Effect by plasterbrain — used for menu click sound.

https://freesound.org/people/plasterbrain/sounds/243020/

Start Menu Music by magmadiverrr — used for start menu background music.

https://freesound.org/people/magmadiverrr/sounds/661248/

Start Menu Hover Sound by plasterbrain — used for button hover sound.

https://freesound.org/people/plasterbrain/sounds/237422/

Talking Bleep Sound Effect by malakme — used for dialogue sound.

https://freesound.org/people/malakme/sounds/468927/

Awkward Sound Effect by plasterbrain — used for awkward dialogue moments.

https://freesound.org/people/plasterbrain/sounds/395502/

Music Loop Bundle by Tallbeard — used for background music.

https://tallbeard.itch.io/music-loop-bundle

Environment Assets

Buildings by El Bolillo Duro — CC0 1.0 Universal, used for building assets.

https://elbolilloduro.itch.io/buildings

Stylized Ground Textures by Kalponic Studio — used for ground and floor textures.

https://kalponic-studio.itch.io/stylized-ground-textures

PSX Multi-Section Apartment Building by Kasuga — used as the main building.

https://kasuga.itch.io/psx-multi-section-apartment-building

PS1 Style Brownstone Buildings by pepperonijabroni — used as building 2.

https://pepperonijabroni.itch.io/ps1-style-brownstone-buildings

PSX Style Barriers by Valse Kamerplant — used for barriers.

https://valsekamerplant.itch.io/psx-style-barriers

PSX Style Walls and Fences by Valse Kamerplant — used for additional fences.

https://valsekamerplant.itch.io/psx-style-walls-fences

PSX Waste by Daniel Jurys — used for trash assets.

https://daniel-jurys.itch.io/psx-waste
